option_relations.rationale: The option describes SVC syndrome caused by a benign lipomatous mass, which is equivalent to the leaf 'SVC syndrome due to lipomatous hypertrophy'.
Cardiac lipomatous hypertrophy with SVC involvement is a broader description that encompasses the specific diagnosis of SVC syndrome due to lipomatous hypertrophy.

Lipomatous hypertrophy of the interatrial septum is a finding mentioned in the vignette and is part of the overall condition leading to SVC syndrome, but it is not the complete diagnosis of SVC syndrome itself.

Interatrial septal lipoma causing SVC compression is a description of the anatomical cause of the SVC syndrome, which is a broader category than the specific diagnosis of SVC syndrome due to lipomatous hypertrophy.
